# agyn_tool (Resource)

Manages an Agyn tool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_tool" "example" {
  name        = "my-tool"
  description = "An example tool managed by Terraform."
  type        = "http"
  config = jsonencode({
    url    = "https://api.example.com/action"
    method = "POST"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Tool type identifier.

### Optional

- `config` (String) Optional JSON-encoded tool configuration. Use `jsonencode()` to construct the value.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the tool.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the tool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the tool.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_tool.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
